chunks: And Moses said: 'O my people, if you have believed in God, then upon Him place your trust, if you are Muslims.'
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between faith and trust in God according to Prophet Moses?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate that true Islam is not merely nominal submission but requires active reliance (tawakkul) on God, a principle emphasized by the Ahl al-Bayt as the essence of faith. The rhetorical structure 'if you are Muslims' implies that tawakkul is the defining characteristic of a true believer, linking theological belief with practical spiritual dependence.
